title: Impact of Bond Downgrade on Equity CAR

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy
Event Study methodology. This is the appropriate causal method because we have a clearly defined event (bond downgrade) with a specific timing, and we want to measure the immediate market reaction around this event. The key assumption is that in the absence of the downgrade event, stock returns would have followed their normal relationship with market returns (i.e., the market model). We identify causal effects by comparing actual returns to expected returns based on pre-event normal performance.

## 2. R Code
```r
# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Read the data
data <- read.csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s56_data.csv")

# Event study analysis
event_study <- function(data) {
  
  # Define event window and estimation window
  event_window_start <- -2
  event_window_end <- 2
  estimation_window_start <- -10
  estimation_window_end <- -3
  
  results <- data %>%
    group_by(stock_id) %>%
    arrange(event_day) %>%
    mutate(
      # Calculate abnormal returns using market model with given beta
      # AR = R_it - (alpha + beta * R_mt)
      # Since we don't have alpha, we'll estimate it from the estimation window
      alpha = ifelse(event_day >= estimation_window_start & event_day <= estimation_window_end,
                    mean(ret[event_day >= estimation_window_start & event_day <= estimation_window_end] - 
                         beta[1] * mkt_ret[event_day >= estimation_window_start & event_day <= estimation_window_end]),
                    NA),
      alpha = first(alpha[!is.na(alpha)]),
      abnormal_return = ret - (alpha + beta * mkt_ret),
      # Mark event window
      in_event_window = event_day >= event_window_start & event_day <= event_window_end
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Calculate CAR for each stock in event window
  car_by_stock <- results %>%
    filter(in_event_window) %>%
    group_by(stock_id) %>%
    summarise(
      CAR = sum(abnormal_return, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Overall statistics
  overall_car <- mean(car_by_stock$CAR, na.rm = TRUE)
  car_se <- sd(car_by_stock$CAR, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(nrow(car_by_stock))
  t_stat <- overall_car / car_se
  p_value <- 2 * (1 - pt(abs(t_stat), df = nrow(car_by_stock) - 1))
  
  # Daily average abnormal returns
  daily_aar <- results %>%
    filter(in_event_window) %>%
    group_by(event_day) %>%
    summarise(
      AAR = mean(abnormal_return, na.rm = TRUE),
      AAR_se = sd(abnormal_return, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      t_stat = AAR / AAR_se,
      p_value = 2 * (1 - pt(abs(t_stat), df = length(unique(results$stock_id)) - 1))
    )
  
  # Print main results
  cat("=== EVENT STUDY RESULTS: Bond Downgrade Impact on Equity CAR ===\n\n")
  cat("Event Window: [", event_window_start, ",", event_window_end, "]\n")
  cat("Number of stocks:", length(unique(data$stock_id)), "\n\n")
  
  cat("CUMULATIVE ABNORMAL RETURN (CAR):\n")
  cat("Average CAR:", round(overall_car * 100, 3), "%\n")
  cat("Standard Error:", round(car_se * 100, 3), "%\n")
  cat("t-statistic:", round(t_stat, 3), "\n")
  cat("p-value:", round(p_value, 4), "\n")
  cat("Significance:", ifelse(p_value < 0.01, "***", ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "**", ifelse(p_value < 0.1, "*", ""))), "\n\n")
  
  cat("DAILY AVERAGE ABNORMAL RETURNS:\n")
  print(daily_aar)
  
  return(list(
    overall_car = overall_car,
    car_se = car_se,
    t_stat = t_stat,
    p_value = p_value,
    daily_aar = daily_aar,
    individual_cars = car_by_stock
  ))
}

# Run the event study
results <- event_study(data)

# Robustness checks
cat("\n=== ROBUSTNESS CHECKS ===\n\n")

# 1. Alternative event window [-1, +1]
cat("1. Narrower Event Window [-1, +1]:\n")
robustness_data <- data %>%
  group_by(stock_id) %>%
  arrange(event_day) %>%
  mutate(
    alpha = mean(ret[event_day >= -10 & event_day <= -3] - beta[1] * mkt_ret[event_day >= -10 & event_day <= -3]),
    abnormal_return = ret - (alpha + beta * mkt_ret)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

narrow_car <- robustness_data %>%
  filter(event_day >= -1 & event_day <= 1) %>%
  group_by(stock_id) %>%
  summarise(CAR = sum(abnormal_return, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

narrow_mean_car <- mean(narrow_car$CAR, na.rm = TRUE)
narrow_se <- sd(narrow_car$CAR, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(nrow(narrow_car))
narrow_t <- narrow_mean_car / narrow_se

cat("Narrow window CAR:", round(narrow_mean_car * 100, 3), "%\n")
cat("t-statistic:", round(narrow_t, 3), "\n")
cat("p-value:", round(2 * (1 - pt(abs(narrow_t), df = nrow(narrow_car) - 1)), 4), "\n\n")

# 2. Check for pre-event drift
cat("2. Pre-Event Period Analysis [-10, -3]:\n")
pre_event_car <- robustness_data %>%
  filter(event_day >= -10 & event_day <= -3) %>%
  group_by(stock_id) %>%
  summarise(CAR = sum(abnormal_return, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

pre_mean_car <- mean(pre_event_car$CAR, na.rm = TRUE)
pre_se <- sd(pre_event_car$CAR, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(nrow(pre_event_car))
pre_t <- pre_mean_car / pre_se

cat("Pre-event CAR:", round(pre_mean_car * 100, 3), "%\n")
cat("t-statistic:", round(pre_t, 3), "\n")
cat("p-value:", round(2 * (1 - pt(abs(pre_t), df = nrow(pre_event_car) - 1)), 4), "\n")
cat("(Should be close to zero if no pre-event information leakage)\n")
```

## 3. Expected Findings
I expect a negative CAR of approximately -2% to -4% over the [-2, +2] event window. Bond downgrades signal deteriorating credit quality and increased financial risk, which should negatively impact equity valuations. The effect should be most pronounced on the announcement day (day 0) and the day after (day +1), as markets digest the implications. The magnitude depends on the severity of the downgrade and the market's prior expectations, but empirical literature typically finds equity CARs between -1% to -5% for bond downgrades, with investment-grade to speculative-grade downgrades showing larger effects.

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: Compare equity CAR before and after bond downgrades.
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: A bond credit rating downgrade leads to a positive change in equity CAR.
